You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Course d'Escargots",
  "slug": "course-d-escargots",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "L'escargot avance tout seul sur la piste, tape l'écran pour sauter les obstacles et ramasser les feuilles. Une collision termine la course et affiche le score final.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "risograph"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `risograph`

# Risograph

The screen looks like a cheap two-colour print: flat ink, grain and a little misregistration.

## Palette

| role    | colour    |
| ------- | --------- |
| paper   | `#fbf7ee` |
| ink one | `#ff48b0` |
| ink two | `#0078bf` |
| overlap | `#5b3a8c` |

## Primitives

- Flat fills in one ink per shape; where the two inks overlap, use the overlap colour.
- Offset the second ink layer by one or two pixels to fake misregistration.
- A grain pass: a pre-rendered noise tile drawn with `globalAlpha` around 0.08 over the whole frame.
- Bold, condensed system type in one ink.

## Avoid

- More than the four colours above.
- Smooth gradients; use halftone dots if a shade is needed.
- Re-rendering the grain every frame; draw the tile once and reuse it.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build the complete game page now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Course d'Escargots</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #fbf7ee;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
    background: #fbf7ee;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---------- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----------
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

// ---------- Setup ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";

let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize() {
  DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  buildGrain();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ---------- Risograph palette ----------
const PAPER = "#fbf7ee";
const INK1 = "#ff48b0";
const INK2 = "#0078bf";
const OVERLAP = "#5b3a8c";

// ---------- Grain tile (pre-rendered) ----------
let grainCanvas = null;
function buildGrain() {
  const size = 128;
  grainCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  grainCanvas.width = size;
  grainCanvas.height = size;
  const gctx = grainCanvas.getContext("2d");
  const imgData = gctx.createImageData(size, size);
  for (let i = 0; i < imgData.data.length; i += 4) {
    const v = Math.random() * 255;
    imgData.data[i] = v;
    imgData.data[i + 1] = v;
    imgData.data[i + 2] = v;
    imgData.data[i + 3] = 255;
  }
  gctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
}

function drawGrain() {
  if (!grainCanvas) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
  const pattern = ctx.createPattern(grainCanvas, "repeat");
  ctx.fillStyle = pattern;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Game state ----------
let last = 0;
let running = false;
let paused = false;
let started = false; // whether boot/start flow has begun
let score = 0;
let scoreShown = -1;

const GROUND_Y_FRAC = 0.75;
let groundY = 0;

let snail = {
  x: 0,
  y: 0,
  vy: 0,
  w: 56,
  h: 34,
  onGround: true,
  jumpForce: -620,
};
const GRAVITY = 1700;

let obstacles = [];
let leaves = [];
let spawnTimer = 0;
let leafTimer = 0;
let speed = 220;
const BASE_SPEED = 220;
const MAX_SPEED = 520;
let elapsed = 0;
let firstHazardSpawned = false;

let clouds = [];
function initClouds() {
  clouds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    clouds.push({
      x: Math.random() * 1000,
      y: 40 + Math.random() * 140,
      s: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8,
      speed: 15 + Math.random() * 15,
    });
  }
}

let tapHintPulse = 0;

function resetState() {
  score = 0;
  scoreShown = -1;
  obstacles = [];
  leaves = [];
  spawnTimer = 1.4; // opening lane clear
  leafTimer = 0.8;
  speed = BASE_SPEED;
  elapsed = 0;
  firstHazardSpawned = false;
  groundY = H * GROUND_Y_FRAC;
  snail.x = W * 0.22;
  snail.y = groundY - snail.h;
  snail.vy = 0;
  snail.onGround = true;
  initClouds();
}

function backToTitle() {
  running = false;
  paused = false;
  started = false;
  resetState();
}

// ---------- Input ----------
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!started) {
    started = true;
    running = true;
    resetState();
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  if (running) {
    act();
  } else {
    // after crash, tap restarts to title-ready state, then next tap starts
    backToTitle();
  }
});

function act() {
  if (snail.onGround) {
    snail.vy = snail.jumpForce;
    snail.onGround = false;
  }
}

// ---------- Host messages ----------
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---------- Spawning ----------
function spawnObstacle() {
  const size = 34 + Math.random() * 20;
  obstacles.push({
    x: W + size,
    y: groundY - size,
    w: size,
    h: size,
    passed: false,
  });
  firstHazardSpawned = true;
}

function spawnLeaf() {
  const y = groundY - 60 - Math.random() * 120;
  leaves.push({
    x: W + 20,
    y: y,
    r: 12,
    taken: false,
  });
}

// ---------- Update ----------
function advance(dt) {
  elapsed += dt;
  speed = Math.min(MAX_SPEED, BASE_SPEED + elapsed * 9);

  // clouds always move for liveliness
  for (const c of clouds) {
    c.x -= c.speed * dt;
    if (c.x < -80) c.x = W + 80;
  }

  // physics
  snail.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
  snail.y += snail.vy * dt;
  if (snail.y >= groundY - snail.h) {
    snail.y = groundY - snail.h;
    snail.vy = 0;
    snail.onGround = true;
  }

  // spawn timers
  spawnTimer -= dt;
  if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
    spawnObstacle();
    spawnTimer = Math.max(0.9, 1.9 - elapsed * 0.02) + Math.random() * 0.6;
  }
  leafTimer -= dt;
  if (leafTimer <= 0) {
    spawnLeaf();
    leafTimer = 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.4;
  }

  // move obstacles
  for (const o of obstacles) {
    o.x -= speed * dt;
    if (!o.passed && o.x + o.w < snail.x) {
      o.passed = true;
      score += 1;
      CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    }
  }
  obstacles = obstacles.filter((o) => o.x > -60);

  // move leaves
  for (const l of leaves) {
    l.x -= speed * dt;
  }
  leaves = leaves.filter((l) => l.x > -40 && !l.taken);
}

function collide() {
  // obstacle collision
  const sx = snail.x + 8;
  const sy = snail.y + 4;
  const sw = snail.w - 16;
  const sh = snail.h - 8;
  for (const o of obstacles) {
    if (
      sx < o.x + o.w &&
      sx + sw > o.x &&
      sy < o.y + o.h &&
      sy + sh > o.y
    ) {
      crash();
      return;
    }
  }
  // leaf pickup
  for (const l of leaves) {
    const dx = (snail.x + snail.w / 2) - l.x;
    const dy = (snail.y + snail.h / 2) - l.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < l.r + 20) {
      l.taken = true;
      score += 3;
      CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    }
  }
}

function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}

// ---------- Drawing ----------
function drawCloud(c) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);
  ctx.scale(c.s, c.s);
  ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(24, -6, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(-22, -4, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawGround() {
  // ground band ink2
  ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);
  // misregistered offset strip ink1
  ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY + 2, W, 6);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // dashes for motion
  ctx.fillStyle = PAPER;
  const dashW = 30, gap = 26;
  const offset = (elapsed * speed) % (dashW + gap);
  for (let x = -offset; x < W; x += dashW + gap) {
    ctx.fillRect(x, groundY + H * 0.06, dashW, 4);
  }
}

function drawSnail() {
  const x = snail.x, y = snail.y;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);

  // shell (ink1) with slight offset ink2 outline for misregistration
  ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(18, 12, 17, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(16, 10, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // shell spiral (overlap color)
  ctx.strokeStyle = OVERLAP;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(16, 10, 9, 0, Math.PI * 1.5);
  ctx.stroke();

  // body (ink2)
  ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, snail.h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-4, snail.h - 14, 10, snail.h - 18);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(30, snail.h - 22, 46, snail.h - 6);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(50, snail.h, 44, snail.h);
  ctx.lineTo(0, snail.h);
  ctx.fill();

  // eye stalks
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK2;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(42, snail.h - 10);
  ctx.lineTo(50, snail.h - 22);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(50, snail.h - 22, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawObstacle(o) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(o.x, o.y);
  // rock shape, ink2 base, ink1 offset top for misregistration
  ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, o.h);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w * 0.15, o.h * 0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w * 0.55, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w, o.h * 0.35);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w * 0.9, o.h);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(2, o.h - 2);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w * 0.15 + 2, o.h * 0.2 - 2);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w * 0.55 + 2, -2);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w + 2, o.h * 0.35 - 2);
  ctx.lineTo(o.w * 0.9 + 2, o.h - 2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawLeaf(l) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(l.x, l.y);
  ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, l.r, l.r * 0.6, Math.PI / 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(1, 1, l.r, l.r * 0.6, Math.PI / 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawScore() {
  ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
  ctx.font = "bold 28px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 16, 16);
}

function drawTitleScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = PAPER;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  for (const c of clouds) drawCloud(c);
  drawGround();
  drawSnail();

  ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 40px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Course d'Escargots", W / 2, H * 0.25);

  tapHintPulse += 0.05;
  const alpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(tapHintPulse);
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
  ctx.font = "bold 26px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Touchez pour commencer", W / 2, H * 0.4);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  drawGrain();
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = PAPER;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const c of clouds) drawCloud(c);
  drawGround();
  for (const o of obstacles) drawObstacle(o);
  for (const l of leaves) if (!l.taken) drawLeaf(l);
  drawSnail();

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(251,247,238,0.85)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.28, W, H * 0.3);

  ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 38px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Course terminée !", W / 2, H * 0.35);

  ctx.font = "bold 28px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
  ctx.fillText("Score final: " + score, W / 2, H * 0.42);

  tapHintPulse += 0.05;
  const alpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(tapHintPulse);
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
  ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Touchez pour revenir au titre", W / 2, H * 0.5);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  drawGrain();
}

function drawGameplay() {
  ctx.fillStyle = PAPER;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  for (const c of clouds) drawCloud(c);
  drawGround();
  for (const o of obstacles) drawObstacle(o);
  for (const l of leaves) if (!l.taken) drawLeaf(l);
  drawSnail();
  drawScore();

  if (paused) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(91,58,140,0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = PAPER;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 32px Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Pause", W / 2, H / 2);
  }

  drawGrain();
}

function draw() {
  if (!started) {
    drawTitleScreen();
  } else if (running) {
    drawGameplay();
  } else {
    drawGameOver();
  }
}

// ---------- Main loop ----------
let booted = false;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  if (!booted) {
    booted = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("boot", {
      title: "Course d'Escargots",
      gameType: "arcade-run",
      lang: "fr",
    });
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

resize();
resetState();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
